answer: Admission passes are macaroons whose caveats narrow what the holder may do, and each delegation adds a caveat, so a pass shared with a farm loses its power with every hop. A farm passing one macaroon to a thousand aliases attenuates it to nothing, while one honest agent holds a full-strength pass and uses it directly. The vault of the design is public, the fable of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the gale of honest work is what finally pays.
